insurer: CIC Life Assurance (CIC Insurance Group, Kenya)
insurer_note: Group site cicinsurancegroup.com only links to country sites; products taken from ke.cicinsurancegroup.com individual-solutions pages. The Kenya individual pages fetched list savings, education and retirement products only; no term life or funeral product was listed there (not confirmed absent elsewhere). cic.co.ke was not fetchable. Most pages omit entry age, minimums and exclusions. Personal Accident is listed but is general insurance, so skipped.

products.name: Academia
products.summary: Endowment policy combining protection and savings to prepare for a child's education costs, with guaranteed partial and final maturity payments.
products.target_client: Parents or guardians saving for a child's education (implied)
products.how_it_works: Savings built through flexible payment plans over the term; guaranteed returns paid as partial maturity and final maturity payments.
key_features: Guaranteed partial and final maturity payments
Premium waiver on parent death or permanent disability
benefits: On policyholder death or permanent disability CIC pays 50% of sum assured immediately plus accumulated bonuses and waives future premiums
Beneficiary still receives full anticipated and maturity benefits
If child dies, refund of premiums paid or nominate another child
Government tax relief of 15% of monthly premiums
analysis_selling_points: Built-in premium waiver and 50% immediate payout on parent death/disability
Guaranteed education payments timed to fee needs
analysis_watch_outs: Entry age, minimum premium, exclusions not published
Child-death outcome is premium refund only
products.source_note: Fetched CIC Kenya savings solutions page.

products.name: Haba Haba na CIC
products.summary: Mobile-phone-based savings plan earning interest with a small built-in life cover.
products.target_client: Low-income or small-ticket savers wanting convenient mobile saving (inferred from page emphasis)
products.how_it_works: Client saves via mobile phone with contributions suited to their budget.
analysis_selling_points: Very low entry point of KES 600
Gateway product to larger CIC plans
analysis_watch_outs: Entry age and exclusions not published
products.source_note: Fetched CIC Kenya savings solutions page.

products.name: Smart Saver
products.summary: Flexible savings and protection plan paying a defined sum assured at maturity or on death.
products.target_client: Individuals saving for goals such as a home, holiday or car
products.how_it_works: Save over a selected term at constant premiums; sum assured paid at maturity or death, including reversionary and terminal bonuses.
benefits: Final lump sum of 100% of sum assured including bonuses
Tax-free investment and tax relief (per page)
analysis_selling_points: Guaranteed benefits and long terms up to 25 years suit goal-based selling
analysis_watch_outs: Minimum premium, entry age, exclusions not published
Optional benefits not detailed on page
products.source_note: Fetched CIC Kenya savings solutions page.

products.name: Jipange Plus
products.summary: Pension plan where members contribute to an existing pension fund registered with IRA, KRA and RBA, so no separate scheme is needed.
products.target_client: Individuals diversifying savings, and organisations wanting a staff pension without registering a new scheme
products.how_it_works: Contributions go into an existing registered fund; administration, fund management, trusteeship and custody are consolidated to reduce costs.
analysis_selling_points: No need to set up own scheme, good for SMEs
analysis_watch_outs: Entry age, minimum contribution, charges not published
products.source_note: Fetched CIC Kenya retirement solutions page.

products.name: Income Draw Down
products.summary: Retirement income product: members draw regular income from an investment fund while the balance stays invested.
products.target_client: Retirees or members taking retirement benefits as regular income
products.how_it_works: Withdrawals capped at 12% a year of outstanding balance; remainder invested and earns market-linked returns.
key_features: Member chooses investment, frequency, timing and amount
benefits: On death fund can pass to beneficiaries as drawdown, annuity or balance payout
After 10 years: continue, buy annuity or take cash lump sum
products.payment_options: Flexible withdrawals up to 12% annual cap
analysis_selling_points: Flexible alternative to buying an annuity
analysis_watch_outs: Minimum entry balance, fees not published
products.source_note: Fetched CIC Kenya retirement solutions page.
